_evidence: 0x0043cb8f adds byte [0x0066d802 + (edx>>1)] (edx = car 0..21, so team 0..10) to byte [ebx+1] and clamps the signed sum to 1..20. The 11 bytes are run-time state: 0x0043cd92 stores them per team (al from 0x0043cc82) every call. The add and the signed compares accept any byte, so all 11 draw any u8 (both clamps and the in-range case).
